derivation.rationale: A common right rotation preserves ||Ri-RijRj||_F. The edge block connection Laplacian reproduces the energy. The bottom eigenvectors solve only the relaxed Stiefel problem; block SO(3) projection does not inherit a global optimum. This is an established synchronization tool and a reserve branch.

assumptions.rationale: Conditional validity requires: The observation graph must connect each synchronized component.; No global optimum or exact recovery is claimed after projecting spectral blocks.; Relative rotations inferred from wrong correspondences can still synchronize coherently to a wrong motion.; An anchored gauge and common reconstruction backend are required. method_expression.rationale: Synchronize model-derived patch rotations, fix one gauge and reconstruct with a qualified common lift. The reviewed construction is SO(3) graph-gauge synchronization, not coordinate smoothing.. This is a specification, not an implemented method.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: The construction predicts: Loop-inconsistent local rotations should improve more than already consistent graphs; independent local fitting should suffice in the latter case.
